notes.title: Occlude Update 1.0.2 & Announcing the Cardinals Update!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hello fellow cultists, occultists and related adherents. A double edition Steam post for you - Updating Occlude to 1.0.3 and announcing a major, free update coming in a couple of months![/p][p][/p][h1]Salutations, Update 1.0.3[/h1][p]This update resolves the last of our outstanding game issues from launch. It includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fixes to typos across the board.[/b] Especially annoying was the misspelling of Tributary, our own company, in the credits. Woops.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanding Game Rules[/b]. Players rightly pointed out that they didn't include wording around Purgatory Slots, and we noticed some confusion with how Undo worked in Classic Mode. We've updated both in the Game Rules.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ongoing controller support[/b]. We know a small number of players on certain devices have had issues with using controllers. We've made some changes to help this. [/p][list][*][p]We could do with some concrete reproduction steps before we can confidently say "it's fixed" so do let us know in the Discussions or comments if you have a recurring issue with using controllers. Do let us know exactly what happened before/after, with what controller setup you were using.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]General bug fixes and stability updates.[/p][/*][/list][p]We now feel confident enough to move onto adding more content to Occlude. Which reminds me...[/p][p][/p][h1]Introducing the Cardinals Update[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/60ebf6b40e9693dde3770bb595eb4ebc3fe7e79a.png"][/img][/p][p]We're extremely excited to announce a [b]major, free update to Occlude[/b] in the Cardinals Update![/p][p]We will be adding over 20 new puzzles to the game, each a variant of one of the seven Rituals, called [b]Cardinals[/b].[/p][p]The rules of each Cardinal will be a new challenge for players, while also being loosely based off their original Ritual. Completing all Cardinals will unlock a new Archive Object and Document for those lore hunters out there.[/p][p]We know fans of Occlude wanted even more puzzles to chew on and we're extremely happy to oblige by more than doubling the amount of puzzles in-game.[/p][p]Currently we're figuring out when this will be ready for you lot to play (as players of Occlude know, timelines are fiddly things to get right). All we can say now is that we're looking at couple of months until they're ready - Please bear with us![/p][p]This update will also come with a number of Quality of Life updates that people have requested which take more time than a smaller update.[/p][p]Let us know what you think in the comments below. Don't forget to hop on our Discord to meet other Obscurants and read our lore drops - There's a new one out today![/p][p]Happy hunting,[/p][p]S[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/e172fc2ef9db92b2f561d9a84339845d37d622de.jpg"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]P.S. - We're trying to get out Trading Cards and Badges out for the game, but Steam keeps rejecting us for fairly vague reasons. Which is fun and fine! After the fourth round of trying to submit these, they hopefully will be with you this week. Apologies for the wait.[/p]

notes.title: Stains That Never Fade
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]There are still unanswered questions. There is still so much more to understand about these Entities and the games they play. Did [b]Occlude[/b] create them? Or did they create [b]Occlude[/b]?
[/p][p]A new piece of evidence has [url="https://table.pantaloon.io/"]landed on my desk[/url]. A photo of Hiroshima, I think, but every time I look back it seems subtly different. And a sequence of numbers.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/5a43b4740789cdbb0e4292a9858cedf786e63aff.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I cannot connect the dots, if indeed there are dots to connect.
[/p][p]One day I will have all the answers. One day I will sleep without these questions tormenting my every waking thought.[/p][p][/p][p]--[/p][p][/p][p][b]The world[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]is a broken machine.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/a2eca57d62952a79a1dd23e7addfdaf645a723ee.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Occlude Update 1.0.2
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]We just can't help ourself - Our second update to Occlude is out! [/p][p]This is another small-ish one, addressing a few missing assets and further improving our controller support.[/p][p]As we said in our previous post the outpouring of support and love for Occlude has been humbling. As has huge amount of feedback![/p][p]We're working our way through your thoughts and comments as we speak, but in the meantime let's dig into what's inside 1.0.2.[/p][p][/p][h1]Welcome, Update 1.0.2[/h1][p]This update has focused on two things - Updating artwork and further improving controller support:[/p][list][*][p][b]Improved Game Rules[/b]. The Game Rules (accessible through the options menu) had images that were thoroughly out of date and the text misleading in more than one place.[/p][list][*][p]All images have been updated and text revisited to make the game clearer for players. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Updated controller support[/b]. Players using Steam Deck and controllers couldn't reach unlocked endings and a few other key parts of the game.[/p][list][*][p]We've corrected this, making sure players can navigate all areas with the controller and done a few tweaks to the controller system.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Update King of Spades art.[/b] He was missing his lower K - Some players thought this was a secret clue and went mildly wild trying to figure out what this intentional error meant.[/p][list][*][p]Sorry to say, it wasn't intentional. As of this update, the King is no longer missing his K.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We've also corrected a few other minor bugs reported.[/p][/*][/list][p]Our next step is currently looking to reviewing save files and improving readability and accessibility. This may take a little longer, so we thought we'd get this easier update out of the way first.[/p][p]Also - We have got Steam Trading Cards and Badges in review. Just waiting on Steam to review and they'll be dropping![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for the outpouring of love. If you haven't yet, go check out the Tributary Games discord, where you will find fellow players, wild theories, lore drops and even a smattering of fan art![/p][p]See you soon.[/p][p]S[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/a2eca57d62952a79a1dd23e7addfdaf645a723ee.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Occlude Update 1.0.1
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hello Obscurants, Magicians and other practitioners.[/p][p]First we wanted to thank you from the bottom our hearts for the response to Occlude at launch. [/p][p]Over 5,000 of you have walked through the door in the rain and we're currently sitting on 86% (!!!) "Very Positive" reviews.[/p][p]We're a tiny team who have worked extremely hard to make Occlude, but it's all been worth it for the reaction at launch. [/p][p]You honestly don't know how much it means to us. Thank you again.[/p][p]Right, enough of the soppy stuff, onto the meat of this post:[/p][p][/p][h1]Introducing Update 1.0.1[/h1][p]Over launch we spotted a few bugs and issues players were having. [/p][p]We jumped straight on this after going live and are pleased to announce Occlude 1.0.1 - A small update to the launch build.[/p][p]This contains:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fixes for Steam Deck players[/b], specifically with moving off the bottom of the Foundations and accidentally hitting "New Deal". [/p][list][*][p]Now when you navigate down from the bottom Foundation (Spades) you return to the top Foundation (Clubs). [/p][/*][*][p]Furthermore, if you navigate up from the top Foundation (Clubs) you instead go to "Undo" rather than "New Deal".[/p][/*][*][p]The next change will also help our Steam Deck players with this issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Also - Steam Deck players - Our Deck setup is very much in Beta! We also have a recommended controller layout uploaded to the workshop. Let us know what you think of these changes and how the game works on Deck in the Discussions section.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Confirmation popups for New Deal and Exit[/b]. On hitting either of these buttons, these small popups show underneath the existing buttons with confirmation buttons.[/p][list][*][p]We've also reworded "Quit" to become "Exit", and this popup explains better than the game will save and then return you to the table, rather than quit the game.[/p][/*][*][p]For long time players this might take a little getting used to, but it was highly requested and we couldn't have so many players losing progress.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fixes for clearing saves and playing Tutorials again[/b]. Previously doing this would occasionally give you a board that wasn't possible to complete while following the tutorials.[/p][list][*][p]We were made aware of this issue shortly before launch but this took a little bit of delicate work to get right. [/p][/*][*][p]Now you can clear saves and replay the tutorial to your heart's content.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fix for the final unlock and Credits showing up twice[/b]. Players who finished the game and then played another Ritual would get the Photograph Object popping up again and Credits roll for a second time - Now, no more.[/p][list][*][p]The Credits will now also not show if you've completed the game in Story Mode only - Instead, a screen encouraging players to give Classic Mode a spin will appear.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We've also corrected a few typos, updated some wording and squashed minor visual bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p]Despite our sturdy build on launch, there's always something that slips through, so we were keen to get these issues responded to as quickly as possible. [/p][p]We're going back to the Occlude mines for more work, which we'll post about soon. [/p][p]If you've spotted an issue let us know in the Discussions! We'd love to help.[/p][p][/p][p]Again, thank you all so much for your support. Also, if you enjoyed Occlude and haven't reviewed the game yet, please do consider it![/p][p]Each review is like recommending the game to five other people in the eyes of the Steam algorithm. [/p][p]We love to read them and appreciate each one massively. No worries if not! We'll see you at the table, either way.[/p][p]Until next time.[/p][p]S[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/a2eca57d62952a79a1dd23e7addfdaf645a723ee.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Sinister new card game brings Balatro's rule-warping brilliance to Solitaire
notes.notes:
Ben Starr's real-life appearances as headlining joker Jimbo aside, nothing about Balatro is particularly sinister. 2024's smash-hit card game is a soothing, number-blasting joy that, as developer 'Localthunk' has stressed, bears none of the gambling overtones of actual poker. But what if you want a darker twist on a family favorite? Enter Occlude. Described as "a ritual disguised as Solitaire," this cosmic-horror card game gives me the unsettling vibes of Inscryption, and developer Tributary Games is burying its secrets just as deeply.

Read the rest of the story...

Roguelike city builder Against the Storm's new DLC adds its seventh species
New WW2 strategy game Battleplan has you command armies with a stroke of a pen
New horror game Shark Dentist is exactly what it says it is, and it's terrifying

notes.title: Take Your Seat at the Table; Occlude is Out Now
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Exuberant greetings to you penitents, supplicants and mendicants![/p][p][b]Occlude[/b], our game of occult solitaire is [b]available right now[/b] on Steam, and we've saved you a seat at the table.[/p][p]Come. Play. Try, fail. Undo your mistakes. Try, succeed. [/p][p]Then break the world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/21999c2f650b3f6b3d47ef8382879332651dd85a.gif"][/img][/p][p]If you played the demo you will have seen only a few of the game's Rituals, but now you can unlock all seven in game.[/p][p]Each of the seven Rituals steadily increase in difficulty, revealing more about the world of Occlude as you unlock the multiple endings, Objects and Documents.[/p][p]We have two game modes to offer: The fiendishly difficult Classic Mode and less tricky but still challenging Story Mode.[/p][p]We're very proud of what we've made with Occlude. We hope you find it pleasantly frustrating, terrifyingly illuminating, and morbidly triumphant in that exact order.[/p][p]I can't wait to see you disappear down the rabbit hole...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/41f2b14dc9e3c9e9099fbcdd41bd3508eb385b96.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Lore Drops[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/b3039f17dbb2c54c4037c04f6f4cddd4a18dbaae.png"][/img][/p][p]As a reminder we're doing [b]Occlude[/b] [b]Lore Drops[/b] every time we hit milestone numbers of Steam Reviews![/p][p]These little snippets of secret lore from our game's world have been specially made for launch by our superb writer Harry Tuffs. Each time we get a certain number of reviews, we'll be uploading them to [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FDhDdKmMs"]our Discord lore-drops channel as soon as humanly possible.[/url][/p][p]Though they're not needed to unravel the mystery of Occlude, they are still fascinating little glimpses into the secret history of this occult game. [/p][p]So please do leave a review - Not just to get the lore drop, but because It helps us out so, so much - Each review pushes Occlude to at least two other people's eyes, who may love the game. So you're doing both us and them a favour![/p][p]Speaking of which...[/p][p][/p][h2]The Eschaton Edition[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/c2f71c2e42c3c490aa74b01c1ab565942de9ab7e.png"][/img][/p][p]Picking up Occlude and leaving a review is honestly all the support we could ever want.[/p][p]Despite this, a few lovely people over the years have asked us "what can I do to support the studio even more?"[/p][p]To those very kind people, we're proud to offer [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56385/The_Eschaton_Edition/"]Occlude: The Eschaton Edition[/url][b]. [/b]This "Support The Devs" style bundle gives you the full game and:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]Occlude Original Soundtrack[/b], by Ed Sibley, featuring 28 minutes of in-game music.[/p][/*][*][p]An bonus [b]Archive Document[/b] as a printable, high-definition PDF, to further fuel your conspiracies and theories.[/p][/*][*][p]The genuine gratitude of a small team with big ambitions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]The Road Ahead...[/h2][p]The end is never really the end, of course. [/p][p]As well as the continuation of our [url="https://table.pantaloon.io/"]Seven Cards, Seven Entities ARG[/url] (there are still two cards to be found), and the start of our Lore Drop series, we'll also be gathering feedback from you obsessively.[/p][p]Once you've played the game consider [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3547010"]heading over to our Discussion page[/url] and sharing your thoughts. [/p][p]We want to hear them, we want to act on them, we want you to come back, see what we've done and be most pleased.[/p][p]Finally, to everybody that's wishlisted, played the demo or joined us on Discord already - The team can't thank you enough for your support. You're as much a part of this game as we are.[/p][p]So what are you waiting for? Go play Occlude. [/p][p]We can't wait to see what you discover. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/a2eca57d62952a79a1dd23e7addfdaf645a723ee.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The Autopsy of [REDACTED]
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]A note was slipped under my office door, alongside a pen drive. Somebody knows I've played Occlude; they must do. But I can't let myself think about that for now. What's more important is the note itself. [/p][p][/p][p]A medical journal entry? Not a doctor's hand, though. A mortician.   [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/9df62564fcb4bab34078ae9516f1a0726a10d31b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Who was she?[/b] Why is her death significant here? [/p][p][/p][p]The drive included a [url="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EbOl-FI_cChh9bOOX8JWgwkqnu5n_WsBQrwEvpTzrIw/edit?usp=sharing"]spreadsheet. [/url][/p][p][/p][p]I've no idea what I'm looking at, but it's clearly important. It's all connected.[/p][p][/p][p]--[/p][p][/p][p][b]The world[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]is a broken machine.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Steam Deck, New Features & Launch Plans
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings you players of world-breaking, mind-shattering "Solitaire Variant meets Lynchian Cosmic Horror At The Sublime Scale" games![/p][p][b]Occlude[/b] will be in your hands in less than one week. Your seat at the table is waiting. [/p][p]We thought we'd put together a little one-week-to-go post with some bits and pieces we've been working on ahead of the release. [/p][p]Like what, I hear you howl, slathering at the mouth, hands wrenching apart the very fabric of reality?[/p][p]Well...[/p][p][/p][h2]Controller Support[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/3e2485d30b4260cf082c80a7341ac967ab529444.gif"][/img][/p][p]While in our humble opinion [b]Occlude[/b] - and Solitaire games in general - are best played with mouse and keyboard, we wanted to support as many of our player's preferred input and control schemes as possible.[/p][p]So we've now implemented controller support, which will be available when the game launches on July 10.[/p][p]A caveat here: While we have tested this as thoroughly as humanly possible, we're a teeny tiny team, so the game has not been played with a controller at scale. [/p][p]Consider it in beta; Usable with likely optimizations to be made. [/p][p]Let us know how you're getting on with it and of any irregularities, and we'll patch these out with all the swiftness we can muster. [/p][p]Also, do you know what controller support makes possible? [/p][p][/p][h2]Occlude On Steam Deck [/h2][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d97705a49661d7c1fad285bf3c5def9ae79a24de.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With controller support now in, we've put Occlude through its paces on Steam Deck and (as far as I'm concerned) it's really rather good.[/p][p]It's important to note Occlude has not attained "Great on Deck" status yet - That's something the most terrifying extra-dimensional entity of them all (Steam) decides whether or not your game gets.[/p][p]However the game suits the handheld experience really well and feels intuitive. But that's not enough![/p][p]What happens next is that we need to let you - the community - play the game on Steam Deck, so we can see how it fares at scale.[/p][p]There's undoubtedly improvements and optimisations we'll need to make, to ensure the controls feel sensible and the experience is perfect for you Steam Deckers.[/p][p]Do let us know if you do play on the Deck in the Discussions after launch, and we'll happily leap on bringing it up to scratch where we can.[/p][p][/p][h2]Our all-new Tutorial  [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/aef3f353b3d1a80b92c5cc0555aef039c278bae4.gif"][/img][/p][p]Our Demo showed that our current Tutorial simply wasn't cutting the mustard. Which is fair! [/p][p]Occlude is an unusual variant of Solitaire, with its own set of tricks to master, as well as having a section of the game where rules intentionally aren't explained to you.[/p][p]Our new fully interactive tutorial is designed to help that. [/p][p]It explains key differences between our new modes, gives you tricks to winning a game and makes it clearer what certain parts of the UI do.[/p][p]We're still very keen for some of our rules (especially around those coins) to remain secret, however we're going to signpost in this tutorial where they are and what they might be better.[/p][p][/p][h2]Even more UI overhauls[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/96b9a748e81c9a5ee553f809d517f9976d9dd96d.gif"][/img][/p][p]You might have seen from [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3547010/view/505080152266375798?l=english"]our last blog post[/url] that we've been improving the information shown to you throughout Occlude.[/p][p]After all, what's the point of a game filled with strategy and secrets if we give you a hint as to what's going on?[/p][p]We're still working on improving the visuals and information across the game, and will do right up to launch. Take a look above for the new and improved visuals for ending a game.[/p][p]Like I said above, we're keen to get the balance right between "showing you everything and spoiling the secret rules of Rituals" and "hiding so much that the game is baffling".[/p][p]What would help that balance for you? Yes, you. I'm literally asking. Go post in the comments below with your thoughts. Right now. Tah.[/p][p][/p][h2]Launch Plans: Lore Drops and more...[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/b3039f17dbb2c54c4037c04f6f4cddd4a18dbaae.png"][/img][/p][p]We have a lot of fun things planned for launch - The final few cards of the ARG, some great coverage by the press, plenty of streamers taking Occlude for a spin.[/p][p]We're also excited to announce that we're releasing Occlude Lore Drops every time we hit milestone numbers of Steam Reviews![/p][p]Those familiar with Tributary will recognize this - We dive into our top secret (and very large) Lore Bible for our games and give you all a forbidden taste of what's inside. [/p][p]These will be a little different from the King of the Castle Lore Drops, as they've been specially prepared and edited by our superb writer Harry Tuffs, and will help you piece together the puzzle that is our narrative.[/p][p]If you want to unlock them, first leave us a review on launch day! (please and thank you so much)[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/DhDdKmMs"]Then join our Discord[/url] to discover even more secrets, plot with your fellow Obscurants, even try your luck at becoming a fabled Magician.[/p][p][/p][h2]Going into Launch...[/h2][p]Final call. [/p][p]Cards on the table. [/p][p]Last chance saloon.[/p][p]We're releasing in roughly five days.[/p][p]So if you haven't wishlisted Occlude yet, please consider it![/p][p]As we move into launch week, every wishlist counts and helps our small team achieve the greatest thing of all: visibility from the great God of Algorithms. [/p][p]Thanks for reading, and we'll see you next week...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: What will be in Occlude at launch?
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings Obscurants, Magicians and other players of the occult. [/p][p]We come bearing news regarding Occlude. First, if you haven't seen, we're [b]releasing[/b] [b]on July 10th[/b], a mere matter of weeks now.[/p][p]Second, we've now taken down the Demo as our full attention has turned to that (very close) launch date.[/p][p]And most importantly we've been hard at work going through your feedback and tightening up the last screws on our unsettling little creature of a game.[/p][p]Let's dive into some launch features and point out a few key differences from the Demo. [/p][p]Starting with...[/p][p][/p][h2]Story Mode[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/52e8ef1ce28a63394279352945996e84ca4c6234.gif"][/img][/p][p]You will now get a choice between playing Occlude on [b]CLASSIC MODE[/b] or [b]STORY MODE[/b]. This option appears at the beginning of the game and again before you start a Ritual.[/p][p]In Classic Mode:[/p][list][*][p]You play Occlude as we intended; Difficult but not impossible. Careful planning will be necessary and we expect you'll need a few New Deals before you complete a Ritual fully.[/p][/*][*][p]You'll get a limited Undo, where once you place a card on the Foundation, you cannot Undo any further. Our single free cell for cards, Purgatory, will still be there to assist.[/p][/*][*][p]You get access to a handful of extra Achievements as a reward for leaping in without a safety net.[/p][/*][/list][p]In Story Mode:[/p][list][*][p]You get the entire narrative experience of Occlude. No story content is locked behind Classic Mode and never will be.[/p][/*][*][p]You get an unlimited Undo, which works even if you place cards on the Foundation, and two Purgatory slots that will help you shift cards around more easily.[/p][/*][*][p]Story Mode has a totally different, easier set of RNG seeds compared to Classic Mode. The game will still be a challenge but the experience will be less punishing.[/p][/*][/list][p]Here's Story Mode in action:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/08aecb3e53754bec9af60780b2d13939d13e0c49.gif"][/img][/p][p]So if you're a hardcore Solitaire fan who enjoys difficult games, choose Classic Mode. [/p][p]And if you want the experience of Occlude minus the frustration, choose Story Mode.[/p][p]Game difficulty was the biggest feedback point from our Demo. For every two people asking "please make Occlude easier!", another would beg "don't change the difficulty!"[/p][p]This solution took a lot of work but hopefully will please both camps. Let us know what you think in the comments below.[/p][p][/p][h2]New RNG for every combination of final cards[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/6f30887c80dba764038aaa624a3d4a663a92bfbe.gif"][/img][/p][p]On top of making new, easier RNG seeds for Story Mode, we changed the code that creates them and crafted a new bank of seeds for you to play with.[/p][p]When Occlude launches every deal you get, whether it's in Story or Classic Mode, for each of the Rituals, will be solveable [i]and[/i] [b]solveable for any combination of final cards.[/b][/p][p]Our Demo had every game solveable for all deals but not for all final cards. We'd envisioned players experimenting, getting stuck and happily hitting "New Deal" plenty of times before completing a Ritual fully. [/p][p]That's just not how people want to play the game! Which is fair, so we've gone ahead and made this change.[/p][p]On top of this we've upped the total number of RNG seeds for launch, with over 1,400 possible seeds split between Story and Classic Mode - meaning more replayability for you.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Archives[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/3118a70317994451d6d1cba8c6f1b95bdd9601d9.gif"][/img][/p][p]Plenty of players asked for more narrative as well as rewards for completing a Ritual with four coins. We secretly already have this - The Archives.[/p][p]We left out these from the Demo as we were keen not the spoil them, but it's worth talking about them now.[/p][p][b]If you complete a Ritual with four coins in any Mode, you'll get access to that Ritual's Archive Object and Archive Document[/b]. [/p][p]The object appears on the table (see above) and selecting it brings up its document (see below). [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/05dcd1c0ca6da1b8335c3d5bbc390307acdaa377.gif"][/img][/p][p](Note we've redacted this document a little for Steam - The version in game will have a fair bit more information for you)[/p][p]The narrative of Occlude is designed to be a puzzle in itself - Piecing documents together as you play, slowly understanding more of our world's lore, and eventually revealing the deep, terrible secrets behind Occlude.[/p][p]We also have different text endings for getting no coins, less than four coins and four coins. Revisiting Rituals to get these outcomes will reveal even more narrative and these will be easier to compare thanks to User Interface changes we're doing for launch (see below).[/p][p]We're keen to see tables fill up with objects earned and hear your theories on launch day.[/p][p][/p][h2]Seven Rituals[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/05aefb48e0cb9a60bb76748103b56653953b601c.gif"][/img][/p][p]We're launching with [b]Seven Rituals that steadily increase in difficulty.[/b] [/p][p]If you played the Demo you've seen the first three already, but the next four are very different beasts. We expect you to complete those considerably slower as they ramp up in complexity.[/p][p]We have plans for more Rituals, however the work we had to do for Story Mode and for other features means they won't be present at launch.[/p][p]It's a shame but we're a tiny team of two developers right now. We have to pick our battles, so are regretfully putting those in the back pocket.[/p][p]We've also been collating feedback on individual Rituals and want to integrate that with any future work we do. Please bear with![/p][p][/p][h2]Improved Art & Menus[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/41f2b14dc9e3c9e9099fbcdd41bd3508eb385b96.gif"][/img][/p][p]We've massively improved information on your previous games - What cards you should have placed in a session, how well you did on previous games, what endings you've unlocked, as well as the ability to revisit those endings.[/p][p]We also heard your feedback about the coins not being clear enough and these have A) increased in size and B) have all new improved artwork with thicker lines and higher contrast:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/468943a28d941fe9453714a4b82525459fc533e1.gif"][/img][/p][p]Beyond that we've made a ton of small visual improvements to better increase readability. We're working on adding more screen sizes also, though this may happen after launch.[/p][p][/p][h2]And more![/h2][p]This is already a mammoth post so we'll finish with the last few Launch features:[/p][list][*][p]New improved tutorial that teaches the rules of the game better[/p][/*][*][p]Updated music and foley [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the start game room with some final touches[/p][/*][*][p]Work for Cloud Saves and Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]An improved intro screen to let you know what you're letting yourself in for...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If there's a particular feature you want to zoom in on, leave a message in the comments below. Thanks for playing, thanks for giving feedback and/or thanks for reading.[/p][p]One last thing - If you haven't wishlisted Occlude yet, please consider it. [/p][p]As we said, we're a tiny indie team with a tiny indie publisher, and getting the word out is increasingly difficult on Steam. [/p][p]Your wishlist tells the algorithm "this game's not terrible" and shows more people Occlude to consider. [/p][p]If you want to do your good deed for the day, why not hit that little button below?[/p][p]See you in the next post.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Earworms and Wet Insects
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]I've had this melody stuck in my head all day. An earworm of unknown origin. A sound playing on repeat, but only in my mind. [b]And only when I'm at the Table.[/b]  And so I've transcribed it - committed the melody to notation. This is new [url="https://table.pantaloon.io"]evidence[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/3d684f312eb9841b8249743413da856c1eaa01c7.png"][/img][/p][p]The sound feels both close and distant at the same time. It carries a sadness. A weight. Despite this, I know I must track it down. 

Where. WHERE is it from. This is the information I need.[/p][p][/p][p]--[/p][p][/p][p]The world[/p][p][/p][p]is a broken machine.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo update - Fixing 'sticky' cards and dates
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings Obscurants! A THIRD update has gone out to the Occlude Demo, which is now on version 0.2.6.[/p][p]This includes:[/p][list][*][p]A fix to stop cards sticking to the player's mouse[/p][/*][*][p]A fix to say that the Demo is not, in fact, from the future, but 2025. The present year. Which is now.[/p][/*][/list][p][u]Make sure you update the Demo to get these changes.[/u] This now brings us up to three Updates in under a week (help me) and joins the following:[/p][list][*][p]An Undo button for any move before committing a card to a Foundation[/p][/*][*][p]Animations to notify players if they need to Undo or Redeal[/p][/*][*][p]Increased speed of cards following the mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Double click to instantly send a card to the Foundation, right click to Mark[/p][/*][*][p]Tableau piles now resizing, so cards don't stack off-screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for Continue/reloading games[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for a bug with clearing saves[/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3547010/view/570381806642135271?l=english"]As we spoke about in our other, longer blog post[/url], we're now working on the following Launch features based off community feedback:[/p][list][*][p]An optional Story Mode that gives you an unlimited Undo, extra Purgatory slots and easier seeds to play with[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the seed generation system across the board, aimed to make sure you can sort the deck without having to place a Final Card early[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorialisation[/p][/*][*][p]More information on past runs, including past coins earned[/p][/*][*][p]More meta-narrative and more rituals (these were planned, but people have asked for them!)[/p][/*][/list][p]This will likely be our final Demo update as the above is taking up 90% of our time.[/p][p]Now, a personal request - We've worked really, really hard on the Demo to date, then to sift through hundreds of feedback points, to then make these changes carefully and quickly.[/p][p]If you like game studios who are dedicated to their craft, why not wishlist Occlude? [/p][p]It's going to be [i]even better[/i] on launch thanks to this Demo and we could do with the help against the dreaded Steam algorithm, who is currently absolutely uninterested in showing Occlude to, well, anyone.[/p][p]Thanks again - We'll talk soon![/p][p]Sam[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Demo update - Undo/Redeal Hints, Card improvements and plans for difficulty.
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to our second update post. If you haven't guessed, we're committed to making Occlude absolutely fantastic for everyone. [/p][p]I hope we've shown this by doing two updates in four days alone![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3547010/view/505078875556941499?l=english"]You can read about the changes we made in the first 24 hours to the demo here.[/url][/p][p]If you're a fan of studios who listen to feedback and games with this level of love in them, please [b]consider wishlisting the game[/b]. [/p][p]Each wishlist boosts us in the Steam algorithm and helps us reach an audience on an increasingly crowded Steam.[/p][p]Our second update brings more highly requested changes to the Occlude demo. Lower down you can read what we're changing for launch based off your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h2]Demo Update 2 Changes[/h2][h3]Undo/Redeal Hints[/h3][p]Players have been requesting help for when their game gets 'locked' - Either when they need to undo a move or can't make any more moves.[/p][p]For both of these cases [b]the Redeal and Undo buttons will now animate[/b]. We hope this removes the frustration some have felt not knowing if they can advance or not![/p][p]Players have also requested a wider Hint system which may take more time. We'd like to see if this change helps before committing to a kind of larger, more design fiddly change such as that. [/p][p]We're a small team, working on an even smaller amount of time, so we sadly have to pick our battles.[/p][p][/p][h3]Snappier Cards, easier movement[/h3][p]A number of players find that moving cards is sluggish and difficult. [/p][p]So, we've [b]sped up the movement of cards when being dragged[/b]. Fling those cards around and please do tell us how it feels![/p][p]This was a great first step, but we [i]also[/i] got feedback that shifting cards to the Foundation was laborious. No more - [b]You[/b] [b]can now double click to send a card straight to the Foundation[/b]. [/p][p]This has meant we've swapped marking cards to a right-click. We know this many make one Ritual marginally harder, so let us know if you like/dislike this change.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cards coming off screen[/h3][p]Players found that with extra big Tableau piles, cards were wandering off the screen and became unclickable. [/p][p]Like we said in the last post, we had a fix in mind for this, and now as of today [b]Tableau piles will resize when lots of cards are placed on them[/b].[/p][p]This works for all game resolutions and is weirdly really fun to do.[/p][p][/p][h3]Wrong Rituals fixed[/h3][p]A bug we started to track after posting our last update was players continuing or loading back into games to find they are playing a different Ritual.[/p][p]This was actually a fun bug - The players weren't actually playing different Rituals, just the asset for the Ritual Card wasn't updating properly. Joy.[/p][p]This update fixes this, so now [b]you won't see the wrong Ritual Card when returning to a game[/b].[/p][p]There were a few other places this was occurring that weren't reported we also fixed, because we're nice like that.[/p][p][/p][h2]Launch changes based on feedback[/h2][p]This responds to 3 of the 5 major bits of feedback we mentioned in the last update. The other 2, plus the many suggestions, ideas and input we've received, are going to take a bit longer to respond to.[/p][p]Some have forced us to redesign the game and do so very carefully, but we're confident these changes make Occlude better for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3]"Casual Mode"[/h3][p]Though a lot of feedback liked the current difficulty, many felt it was too punishing. [/p][p]Many more specifically asked for a casual mode and we're now working on this.[/p][p]Our current thinking is that this would have an unlimited undo and two purgatory slots, as well as its own set of seeds that are easier to complete. [/p][p]Naming to be confirmed, as "casual" sounds a little derogatory for our liking.[/p][p]We also realized that lots of players simply didn't expect the 'Occlude Experience' - A tricky game of Solitaire where Redealing is encouraged and failure expected. That's on us. [/p][p]We're look at messaging to make it abundantly clear to players what the game is about, while pointing to this "casual" mode as an option they may be interested in.[/p][p]By doing this, we don't affect the many players who like the current challenge of Occlude, who still get the difficulty and chewy version that's closer to this demo.[/p][p][/p][h3]RNG Difficulty/Balance[/h3][p]For both modes of Occlude we're generating new seeds to go into the game using a much altered seed generation system.[/p][p]These new seeds will be solve-able for all combinations of Final Cards. Our original thinking was that players wouldn't mind an occasional Redeal, but feedback has shown quite the opposite. [/p][p]These will also allow for simpler first moves so you can get a game started faster.[/p][p]For non-"casual" mode the seeds will be slightly easier than the demo but still tough, and for "casual" mode these will be considerably easier all round.[/p][p]We're also looking at detecting when players are struggling and throw them a bone with an easier seed.[/p][p]This is a massive undertaking and has taken us away from the many other features we want to add to Occlude, but we're confident it'll improve the game for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tutorialisation[/h3][p]Our current very basic Tutorial is not cutting the mustard! Feedback was really clear about that.[/p][p]We're allocating time to work on a more in-depth Tutorial that will guide players through the start of a game better.[/p][p]Tutorials are generally awful to make in games, so how extensive this will be down to how much time we get for it. Tiny team, tiny budget, tiny amount of time.[/p][p][/p][h3]Review screen[/h3][p]You want somewhere to see how many Coins you've earned, a few stats and even revisit old narrative that showed up? Sure thing![/p][p]We had planned this for launch, but your feedback has made us change how this will look - You clearly want lots of information about your runs and we want to give it to you.[/p][p][/p][h3]Meta-Narrative/More Rituals[/h3][p]Players want both more of a meta-narrative to the game and more Rituals to complete. [/p][p]That's a nice and easy bit of feedback to answer - We have both, but you'll have to wait for the full game to see it.[/p][p][/p][h2]Happy? Wishlist us![/h2][p]Thank you all again for your feedback. [/p][p]I can't lie, it's been tough read in places, but most of you have been wonderfully polite and understanding about the difficulties of indie game development.[/p][p]That feedback has made [u]Occlude fundamentally better[/u] - Better than when we first released the demo and better for launch. [/p][p]We now have a clear path to follow when Occlude hits your Store page on the [b]10th of July[/b].[/p][p]If you appreciate what we're doing, go wishlist Occlude. Like I said above, it helps us more than you can imagine.[/p][p]I'll keep up the updates and let you know how your feedback shaped the game.[/p][p]Thanks again,[/p][p]Sam[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Demo update - Undo button, clear save fixes and your feedback so far.
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]We've had a ton of feedback on our new Occlude Demo for NextFest. Plenty positive, a few negative, and the vast majority asking for one feature above all - An Undo button.[/p][p][/p][h2]Undo Button[/h2][p]Partly because we had a great deal of early feedback saying the difficulty was "just right" and partly for Secret Reasons that'll become obvious when you play the final game, an Undo mechanic was something we were planning for after the NextFest Demo.[/p][p]However it's become abundantly clear from feedback the Undo is absolutely necessary and necessary right now. So, your past mistakes can now be undone - We've worked at breakneck speed overnight [b]to bring you an Undo button[/b].[/p][p]For those of you concerned this will make the game trivial, do not worry - This won't let you undo [i]everything[/i].[/p][p]You can now undo moves up to the point you put a card in the Foundation. What this means is, if you accidentally lock yourself by moving cards around the Tableau (a common complaint), you don't have to reshuffle with a New Deal every time.[/p][p]Make sure you update the Demo to get this change and let us know what you think.[/p][p][/p][h2]Clearing Save Files[/h2][p]We've also had feedback saying that clearing game saves have had a few issues, including odd animations and game softlocks. We've identified this problem and pushed up that change to the demo with the Undo button update.[/p][p]If you're playing on old branches from playtesting and wanted to clear your saves manually, don't forget you can copy paste [u]%USERPROFILE%\\\\AppData\\\\LocalLow\\\\Tributary Games\\\\Occlude\\\\Saves[/u] into your File Explorer to delete SAVEFILE.save in there.[/p][p][/p][h2]Feedback: Next Steps[/h2][p]We're not stopping there, of course. As a studio we pride ourselves on listening to our player's feedback and making changes based off of them.[/p][p]We're looking at five major bits of feedback we've had in the first 24 hours:[/p][list][*][p][b]RNG difficulty/balance[/b] - We're hearing that the shuffle of cards in a new game is causing headaches for players. Essentially - [b]You feel like the difficulty is too high[/b]. We're looking at our generation system to get you into the flow of Occlude quicker while keeping the challenge for those of you who enjoy the current level of difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Locked game indicator[/b] - You're asking for better feedback when a game can't be advanced, so we're taking a look at making the Undo and Reshuffle buttons animate, depending on game state, to make it clearer when you need to use them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speed/'snappiness' of cards[/b] - People are finding card movement too sluggish. That's a nice straightforward fix which we can get on straight away.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cards coming off screen[/b] - We're aware that with certain resolutions sizes larger stacks of cards are coming off the screen. We have a fix for this we're working on right now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Casual Mode[/b] - Lots of players are asking for a casual mode. This one is difficult - We're a small team and this would mean we'd have to build a whole other game mode in a short time, taking us away from vital other work. We're looking at our backlog of jobs to do and figuring out what can be done in the time and budget we have. No promises, I'm sorry to say, but we have some ideas how we can help.[/p][/*][/list][p]There is, of course, more feedback than this - But we've determined these are our top targets from the first 24 hours.[/p][p]If your feedback isn't above [u]we've still recorded it[/u] and endeavor to answer it in time.[/p][p][/p][h2]And finally...[/h2][p]Thank you all so, so much for the feedback.[/p][p]Making games, especially at the size we are, isn't easy and we don't always get it right the first time. We're sadly only human. However, with your feedback, we can make Occlude something really special.[/p][p]Please be patient while we do this![/p][p]I'm super happy we got this change out in under 24 hours, but making a game is anything but easy and we have to balance finishing the game with feedback changes. It's a balance we don't always get right, but one we're committed to doing so.[/p][p]So go update the Demo, give it a spin, tell us what you think, and we'll keep on hammering away at code in the background. Expect some more updates soon.[/p][p]Sam[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The Occlude Demo has arrived.
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img]

Passed down between generations, lost to dark rooms and hidden spaces, and now [b]Occlude[/b] finds its way to [i]you[/i].  [/p][p][/p][p]As part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], the first public demo for [b]Occlude[/b] is here, bringing with it the first three Rituals from the game.  [/p][p][/p][p]We've also released a [b]brand new trailer[/b] for the game... 
[/p][previewyoutube="M7xYWr9hHKc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Once again, this is not Solitaire. Not in a form you'll be familiar with at least. And that's why we'd love to know what you think. [b]Occlude[/b] is not an easy game - cryptic by design - and we'd love to know how you get on with it. 
[/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd_pp9XwLbMMC0nWgn3nsyxTjkZLeoTVBwhVaaJa3le7qrxFQ/viewform" style="button"]Let us know what you think![/url][/p][h2]
[b]Official Occlude Streams for Next Fest[/b] 
[/h2][p]As part of the Next Fest celebrations, we have [b]Should You Play It[/b] and others (to be announced very soon!) with official streams of the game, as well as an upcoming [url="https://discord.gg/m8svpb9g?event=1380562749662298314"]Dev Stream[/url], with Sam and Owen of Tributary Games offering Director's commentary - possibly dropping some exclusive insight into the story and lore of the game as they play. You can watch this live at [b]19.30 BST on Tuesday 10th June[/b] - after which it will available here on Steam, too.  [/p][p][/p][h2]New Evidence Emerges[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/2b11f17c81ea55e703caa5bab198db473e632b6d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And finally, in case you missed it, new evidence has just surfaced in the [url="https://www.table.pantaloon.io"]Investigation into Occlude[/url]. If you're interested in throwing yourself down an ARG rabbit hole in search of additional mystery and lore, there's no time like the present. [/p][p]The Investigation is far from over. Be vigilant.

[i]The world   [/i][/p][p][i]is a broken machine.[/i]   [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img]

notes.title: Endings as beginnings, and beginnings as endings.
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]New evidence has found its way onto [url="https://table.pantaloon.io/"]my desk[/url].[/p][p]A photo of a room. A space long abandoned, long forgotten.[/p][p]Something happened here that changed the world and kept it the same. Was [b]Occlude[/b] played in this space, many years ago?[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeEm45twX4od5j281jTThKj7OhQpQqeRYHQTG0FI-8zB3LIvZBBewqDHWPHJcW8aAwyEvV-gmNV4CzZiOABuF11JB6MI59TzElOOb7OaYtkcQJNZXwrXYeJFsvdUxJ-TbY1n7mIEQ?key=JdPWdAAGCpiM6-sz453C3w"][/img][/p][p]I find myself [i]reflecting[/i].[/p][p]I've changed since throwing myself down this rabbit hole. Everything’s changed.[/p][p]Ideas once banal and spaces once empty are now pregnant with \[url=[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/"][/dynamiclink]]meaning\[/url] and energy. [i]Everything[/i] has intention, there are no mistakes.[/p][p]I can say the same for myself. The more I learn about [b]Occlude[/b], the less I recognise the thoughts and spaces inside myself.[/p][p]I stare into the mirror, but am no longer sure whose face looks back.[/p][p]Something is happening. Others will soon find this game. Very soon. And I cannot protect them.[/p][p][/p][p]The world[/p][p][/p][p]is a broken machine.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Do they call to us, from the other side of the rain?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif[/img]

I haven’t dared play [b]Occlude[/b] yet. 

My sins are a part of me. If I change what I have done, do I change who I am? Will I - the one writing this - even survive, in meaningful form?

And yet, I long to play it. I lay out the cards, one by one. The foundations. The tableau. The focus. 

The coins.

I sit there in what would be silence, if not for the drumming of the rain on my window panes. I stay in that silence for some time. Wrap it round me like a blanket. 

And then I hear something. 

Do they call to us, from the other side of the rain?

I tried to capture it. If the Castle found out how close I came, I’d be due for a dose of the blue stuff; so I have used my usual security methods, not that they're very advanced, [i]furrfu[/i].

There are things on the other side of the rain. They’re waiting for me to open the door.

If I get it wrong, I’ll know.

The world 

is a broken machine. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Seven Cards. Seven Entities.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif[/img]

This is not Solitaire. Or at least not as you know it.

It's a [b]ritual[/b] - or so testimonies from the unresolved case files say - passed down from generation to generation, played in isolation in back-rooms and forgotten spaces. 

We understand the framework - the ways in which a player might interact with the "game" - but we don't understand much more than that; what happens after. The pacts that seem to be made. The rules that govern them.  

Today the investigation into [b]Occlude[/b] must begin in earnest; its secrets documented, the anomalies in its design studied. [b]The case is now open[/b], if you can find the Investigation Board... 

[h1]Seven Cards. Seven Entities.[/h1]

The case is now open, but don't expect everything all at once. Investigations like this take time, and will take us right up until release.  

There are seven entities, we believe.  

And we've been offered seven cards. A coincidence?  

But they are not given up so easily - they require an offering; a word that connects their physical manifestation in this realm, to their abstract meaning in another.  

Find the [b]Table[/b] and the [b]Investigation Board[/b]. The evidence found so far has been password protected. Today is just the beginning. 

[url=https://www.gutenberg.org/files/21642/21642-h/21642-h.htm?utm_source=chatgpt.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/3906807d8ff37a9e3bd143bffe91b12c2a64d39b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]The door in the rain[/h1]

Did you open the door in the rain already? It is not locked. There is still time. This is not required to begin your investigation, but it's nice to have everything in one place.   

[url=https://www.pantaloon.io/join-us-at-the-table][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/bb932691b3584f3c57d960047f7579ab317f08e1.png[/img][/url]

Seek the four. Unite the suits.

For now we conclude, then. But there is more to come.  

The world 

is a broken machine.

notes.title: Introducing Occlude; An occult ritual disguised as Solitaire.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif[/img]

Hello! Sam from [b]Tributary Games[/b] here. We're a studio that makes novel, systemic games - perhaps you played or saw [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839880/King_Of_The_Castle/][b]King of the Castle?[/b][/url] That was us!

After announcing [b]Occlude[/b] in a mysterious manner last month (anyone manage to open the [url=https://www.pantaloon.io/join-us-at-the-table]Door in the Rain?[/url]), we're finally ready to put our cards on the table. 

Today we've lifted the lid on our studio's next game, with the first details, features and screenshots laid bare. Say hello to [b]Occlude[/b] - A single-player cosmic-horror card game for the terminally curious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/c8f45c9d6d81a863406ef9c8a6ef511fbab98cf7.jpg[/img]
[b]Occlude[/b] is smaller and tighter than KOTC, but just as ambitious. It's Solitaire, yes, but much, much more. It's got puzzle mechanics, and a mind-bending narrative that's a puzzle in it's own right. It's a game that is one thing but also another.

I know that's frustratingly vague! We want you to go into [b]Occlude[/b] with a fresh mind - I can't give too much away. What we [i]can[/i] say, is that the game is about discovery and experimentation...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/83fb1b3553fbe4637e4028c72e32fe1700dfafdf.jpg[/img]
Some of the rules are hidden, and you find them by playing and experimenting. The coins will show when you’re on the right path. There are seven Rituals, each their own puzzle, increasing in difficulty.

As you play, you unlock new Rituals, and as you master them you gain access to deeper, forbidden lore in the Archives. As you chip away at reality one card at a time, you'll piece together a Lynchian horror story about the nature of regret and reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/98e73cddac531d39301d9c663535df83ecdb2495.jpg[/img]
Sound good? Then go [b]Wishlist the game[/b]! It helps us massively - We're a tiny studio absolutely slaving away at a much loved, little razor-sharp scalpel of a title.

Your wishlist means the algorithm is more likely to pick us up - That's the only way games like ours can survive on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif[/img]

And this is, of course, just the beginning. The world of [b]Occlude[/b] is already spilling out from the game.

There is more to discover - but only for those dedicated enough to seeking the truth.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude/
